design_rule: Reuse current VOLC Layout/Card/Button/Badge/table/chart tokens and Google/Meta operational language. Differences only provider-required hierarchy, objective/event, identity and eligibility; no Google API interaction or redesign.
mutation_safety: UI protection against duplicateclick is UX only; DB dispatch owner enforces concurrency across tabs/actors. UI cannot choose eligibility, approve itself or treat stale input as safe.
